features: Analog Turbo HD (TVI) over coax/BNC — NOT an IP camera
ColorVu 3.0 24/7 full-color imaging with F1.0 aperture
HikAI-ISP with AI DNR noise reduction
Smart-Hybrid light: IR up to 30m and white light up to 30m
Two-way audio with built-in mic and speaker (audio over coax)
Active strobe light alarm (red and blue) and audible alarm
release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2CE67DV0T-PTLXTS is an analog Turbo HD 2MP ColorVu 3.0 fixed PT camera with 24/7 color imaging, Smart-Hybrid IR/white light to 30m, two-way audio and a strobe-plus-siren alarm.
